title: Your Rulebook

launchpad.outcome: Assemble MY AGHF RULEBOOK: your model’s rules, your risk, your session and your five non-negotiables.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What will I read before every session?

say: Everything you’ve felt in this phase, you’ll feel again.
After a win. After a loss. On a slow Tuesday. With rent due.
So right now, while you’re calm, you’re going to write the voice that speaks for you then.

beats.principle: THIS ISN’T A LIST OF RULES. IT’S A LETTER FROM CALM-YOU TO EMOTIONAL-YOU.

slides.title: MY AGHF RULEBOOK
slides.punch: REVIEW MODE: editable. SESSION MODE: read-only. Open it any time from your Academy.

slides.quote: Read it before every session. Out loud, if you have to. 😂

slides.modelAnswer: My five are the rules I don’t negotiate during a session. They change only in review, with evidence.

takeaways: Your rulebook speaks when you can’t.
remember: A LETTER FROM CALM-YOU TO EMOTIONAL-YOU.
